name: getuserfeedback
description: User feedback as a signal your agent reads: set up the ask, read what comes back, fold it in with the rest. Not a separate dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Bring user feedback into your agent workflow.
interface.longDescription: Create and improve surveys, review responses and inbox activity, and follow up with users through the authenticated getuserfeedback.com connection.
defaultPrompt: What have my users been saying lately?
Create a short survey about my latest product launch.
Show me the feedback that needs a follow-up.
